title: Scope opportunity ranking to selected scorecards
description:
As an optimization operator, I want to restrict portfolio ranking by exact scorecard IDs or literal name prefixes, so that I can focus analysis without losing complete-coverage guarantees.

Out of scope: fuzzy matching, regex/glob selectors, alternate ranking paths, automatic optimization, and client-specific policy.

Feature: Scoped optimization opportunity ranking

  Scenario: Rank exact scorecard identifiers
    Given a completely enumerated account scorecard collection
    When ranking is requested with exact opaque scorecard identifiers
    Then only matched identifiers are analyzed
    And every identifier reaches downstream analysis unchanged

  Scenario: Rank literal scorecard name prefixes
    Given scorecard names with different letter casing
    When ranking is requested with one or more literal name prefixes
    Then matching is case-insensitive and prefix-only
    And the union of exact and prefix matches is deduplicated

  Scenario: Preserve scoped coverage evidence
    Given a scoped ranking request
    When enumeration and downstream analysis complete
    Then the packet reports requested selectors, matches, unmatched selectors, inspected count, and complete coverage

  Scenario: Return an exact empty scoped result
    Given complete scorecard enumeration with no selector matches
    When scoped ranking completes
    Then the result is exactly empty
    And downstream feedback analysis is not invoked

  Scenario: Reject ambiguous empty scope
    Given an explicitly supplied selector field with no values
    When ranking is requested
    Then the request is rejected instead of becoming account-wide

  Scenario: Never overstate partial scoped evidence
    Given enumeration or downstream analysis fails
    When scoped ranking returns partial evidence
    Then the result is marked incomplete and not exact

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented scorecard-scoped opportunity ranking with exact opaque-ID selectors, literal case-insensitive name-prefix selectors, union and deduplication, exhaustive enumeration before local filtering, exact zero-match behavior, scope coverage evidence, and scope-bound fingerprints. Local validation is complete: focused runtime suite 270 passed; full Python 3.11 and 3.12 suites each 3,940 passed with 13 dispatch-regression tests passing on each version; version synchronization, lock validation, lint, and diff checks passed; Node 20 dashboard typecheck and 650 unit tests passed; Storybook built and 700 Chromium tests passed. Independent implementation, CI, and delivery audits found no blocking defects. The story remains in progress until the change merges to develop.

comments.text: Final integration validation completed after merging current develop. The merge exposed and resolved two compatibility issues: the dependency manifest now keeps the MCP framework on its supported major version, and input-source tests use the repository's explicit score-class resolver. Final results on the merge commit: Python 3.11 and 3.12 each passed 3,931 tests with 13 dispatch-regression tests passing per version; focused optimization/runtime coverage passed 293 tests; lint, version synchronization, lock validation, and diff checks passed. The unchanged dashboard tree retains the validated Node 20 results: typecheck, 650 unit tests, Storybook build, and 700 Chromium tests. The tracked scorecard-path symlink was restored after test-generated filesystem changes. Ready for PR review; keep this story open until merge to develop.
